voiceover: You run your app and get: port 3000 is already in use. But you closed it. You're sure you closed it. A server is still running in a forgotten terminal tab. A port is a numbered door on your computer, and only one app can listen on each door at a time. Find what's using it and stop it, or start your app on another port. Boring fix. Annoying error. Send this to whoever has eight terminals open.
